description: Official MailChannels skills for sending transactional email from any app

plugins.name: mailchannels
plugins.description: MailChannels Email API is a transactional email API for any application: password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications. Send over REST or SMTP with official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, or keep Laravel Mail, Symfony Mailer or Nodemailer and switch the transport. REST payloads support HTML/text content, attachments and per-recipient personalization. The asynchronous REST send returns a request ID, and signed delivery webhooks carry that ID through processed, delivered, bounce and complaint events; metrics report delivery and volume by time range and campaign. Sender IDs can separate reputation for distinct mail streams within an account or sub-account. Optional sub-accounts give each customer or agent its own credentials and limits when they send through your product. Outbound only; free developer plan for development and testing.
